## Repost it, do not edit it

Reposting with credit is welcome. You can share the videos on any account and in any format, for any purpose, even commercially.

Edits are not. If you remix, transform or build upon the material, you may not share the result. A new voice-over or a translation counts as a change.

## Credit line

Put this line next to anything you repost:

```text
Zero to Shielded by zkasuran, CC BY-ND 4.0, https://github.com/zkasuran/zero-to-shielded
```

Where you can, link "CC BY-ND 4.0" to the licence page above. Do not suggest that the author endorses you or your post.
